errors.text_span: Представителни стойности са: 1,1% и 16,7% за "няма", 3,4% и 25,2% за "до 10%", 29,2% и 26,8% за "над 10 до 25%", 47,1% и 18,8% за "над 25 до 50%", 16,1% и 9,1% за "над 50 до 75%", 3,0% и 3,4% за "над 75%".
errors.evidence: The description lists pairs of numerical values for each category without explicitly assigning them to their respective series ('В страната' or 'В бранша'). This makes it impossible for a reader to know which value belongs to which series without referring back to the chart, significantly reducing the clarity and usefulness of the data reporting.
The description fails to mention the colors used to differentiate the two series: light green for 'В страната' and light blue for 'В бранша'.
